new_user_requirements.title: Use a versioned active provisional north star that can be refined from evidence and experience
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Every GoalVersion preserves exact predecessor wording, reason, evidence, retained/changed meaning, active interval and compatibility; the current readable view identifies the active provisional goal and held candidates

new_user_requirements.title: Give every consequence-changing goal refinement a complete impact graph and independent activation path
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Material GoalChange records alternatives/dissent and impacts on parties, scope, authority, requirements, architecture, threats, privacy/security, licensing, Bridge, metrics, tests, phases, migration and acceptance; it cannot activate itself or silently cancel owner requirements

new_user_requirements.title: Keep metrics subordinate to the plural goal and anti-goals
new_user_requirements.acceptance: No engagement, obedience, scale, agreement, rank or single outcome metric can redefine the mission or offset a violated participant-right, security, privacy, non-domination or recovery constraint

changes.change: Add GoalVersion with exact wording, source, predecessor, retained/changed semantics, evidence, active interval and work compatibility.
Separate clarifying wording updates from consequence-changing GoalChange and require the latter's complete impact graph, dissent and independent activation.
At every milestone test the active goal against evidence and record a bounded refinement or justified NO_CHANGE without forcing novelty.
Trace each metric to one success dimension and all anti-goals; reject metric-driven mission drift and prohibit cross-dimension offset of rights/security/privacy/recovery failures.
Test silent requirement cancellation, self-authorized goal expansion, metric capture, incompatible in-flight work, hidden dissent and rollback/forward-recovery of goal changes.

implementation_state: GOAL_GOVERNANCE_SPECIFICATION_ONLY; no scope, actor, authority, feature or phase activation follows
